summary.zh-CN: 重要会话持续置顶，定时任务结果集中查看，长会话日志更紧凑。
summary.en-US: Persistent session pins, a dedicated Scheduled view, and smaller conversation journals.

title.en-US: Browse task results in a dedicated view

body.zh-CN: 桌面和手机可集中查看任务创建的专属会话，支持搜索、分页和视图选择持久化。绑定到已有普通会话的任务保留原有分类。
body.en-US: Desktop and mobile offer a dedicated view for task-created conversations, with search, pagination, and persistent selection. Existing regular conversations bound to tasks retain their classification.

title.en-US: Retain pins across refreshes and restarts

body.zh-CN: 置顶保存在实例中并优先于普通会话分页；旧浏览器置顶自动迁移，保存失败时恢复原状态并提示错误。CLI 支持 sessions pin 和 sessions unpin。
body.en-US: Pins are saved in the instance and ordered before regular pagination. Existing browser pins migrate; failed saves restore the previous state and show an error. The CLI supports sessions pin and sessions unpin.

title.zh-CN: 合并流式增量与手动整理
title.en-US: Coalesced streaming deltas and manual maintenance

body.zh-CN: 相邻流式增量合并记录，减少日志占用。sessions compact-journal 支持预览与带备份的整理；应用和恢复前必须停止同一 HOME 的全部实例。普通升级不会自动整理旧日志。
body.en-US: Adjacent streaming deltas are coalesced to reduce journal size. sessions compact-journal previews maintenance and retains a backup. Stop all instances using the same HOME before applying or restoring. Upgrades do not automatically rewrite old journals.

title.zh-CN: 保持提问顺序与用户换行
title.en-US: Preserve question order and user line breaks

body.zh-CN: 异步提问保留在助手消息原来的位置；用户消息的普通换行在发送和重新打开会话后正确显示。
body.en-US: Asynchronous questions remain at their original position in assistant messages. Ordinary user message line breaks display correctly after sending and reopening conversations.

body.zh-CN: 刷新入口统一放在宿主标签的更多操作中，无需关闭应用，保留应用数据和授权。
body.en-US: Refresh from the host tab's additional actions without closing the app, retaining app data and permissions.
